thread:
Alex: Kickoff: Prospect 'Nautical' wants a phased swap from CompetitorX. Minimal client changes, token billing parity, prompt/slot parity, and on-prem fallback. Can we list blockers?
Jess: Clarify  identical endpoints or drop-in behavior? Sales said 'minimal changes'.
Samir: Eng risks: tokenization mismatch (output drift), custom session header X-Client-Session, and stop-sequence semantics differences. Need their eval set to measure.
Olga: Token shim plan: unicode NFC normalize, collapse repeated whitespace, apply small token mapping for common divergences. Usually reduces top-1 deltas.
Samir: We can honor X-Client-Session and do sticky routing to Dedicated pools. Need to validate affine behavior under load.
Meera: Legal asks: no-training clause, 90d retention, exportable audit logs. Drafting addendum now.
deploy-bot: presales job queued: nautical-compat-shim -> staging (job 5555).
Alex: Pricing ask  quantify delta if we use quantized variants vs CompetitorX. Samir?
Samir: Ballpark: quantized on Dedicated ~0.55-0.7x per-token; p50 latency +8-15%, p95 +10-25% depending on batch size. Adding conservative numbers to cost sheet.
Jess: Proposed POC acceptance: Top-1 intent parity >=95% on their eval set; p95 latency within 25% of CompetitorX; reconciled billing script + sample report. Target 2-week POC.
Alex: Action items: Samir -> baseline CompetitorX runs + cost workbook; Jess -> request eval set + staging creds; Olga -> SOC2/KMS excerpts + allowlist IPs; Meera -> legal addendum.
Jess: Smoke test for staging (share with customer):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Session: 77" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/nautical-shim/generate
```
Alex: I'll ping sales for the eval set and update the thread. Marking presales-nautical for follow-up.
